fusions.name: Mile in the Legs
fusions.desc: A kick at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 30 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full range, and always lands as a critical hit. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +50%).

fusions.name: Road Grit
fusions.desc: Scuffs a cone of road grit up to 4 tiles ahead, dealing 7 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Blunted] for 5 seconds. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: March Together
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Milestone Counter
fusions.desc: On paved ground, you deal 12% more damage.
